decision.reasoning_trace: The consideration set focuses on established audio brands (Harman Kardon, Sony, JBL, Audio Pro) and a well-rated mid-range option (Raymate). I filtered out accessories like power cords and cases. The Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_116) was selected as the final choice because of its high rating (4.7), strong brand reputation for bass and clarity, and IPX7 waterproof rating, making it a versatile and high-quality speaker for the price point. While the Sony and Audio Pro options offered higher technology features like 360 audio and multi-room support, their reviews indicated some connectivity and app issues, whereas the Harman Kardon reviews were more consistently positive about the core listening experience.
